title: Bear cub eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#3a2f52'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='16' ry='15' fill='#e0a866'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='62' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#c47a34' transform='rotate(-20 28 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='62' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#c47a34' transform='rotate(20 72 62)'/>
  <!-- paws holding snack -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='6' fill='#e0a866'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='55' r='6' fill='#e0a866'/>
  <!-- snack: honey cookie -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='9' fill='#f4c542'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='49' r='1.8' fill='#a8761a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#a8761a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#a8761a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='10' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='10' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='5.5' fill='#e0a866'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='30' r='5.5' fill='#e0a866'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#b06a2c'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#e0a866'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='34' r='3.4' fill='#2a1a3e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='34' r='3.4' fill='#2a1a3e'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#fef3e0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='33' r='1.2' fill='#fef3e0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='3.6' ry='2.8' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <!-- mouth, happy & chewing -->
  <path d='M44 47 Q50 53 56 47' stroke='#5a3a1e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='42' r='3' fill='#d96a6a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='42' r='3' fill='#d96a6a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#c47a34'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='88' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#c47a34'/>
</svg>
